**Paperhue 0.3.0** adds calendar pages and a message board to the free
Windows app for ULANI e-paper devices (ULANI 永恆曆).

Each of the device's four pages can now hold a photo, your calendar, your
to-do list or notes you write, chosen with the page's new **顯示** (Show)
menu.

## What's new

### Calendar pages

Three new page kinds, drawn like phone widgets: **月曆** (month calendar),
**一週行程** (week agenda) and **待辦清單** (to-do list). They come from
your own calendars' iCal (.ics) addresses, such as Google Calendar's secret
address in iCal format, an Outlook published calendar or a Nextcloud to-do
list. No account, API or sign-in is involved.

- **行事曆來源…** (Calendar sources…) adds, edits and removes sources.
  Each address is checked once before it is saved.
- **立即同步** (Sync now) updates the pages straight away.
- **每日排程…** (Daily schedule…) lets Windows Task Scheduler update them
  at fixed times every day (06:00, 12:00 and 18:00 unless you change them).
  The PC must be on and signed in to Windows; times missed while it was off
  or asleep are made up when it is back.
- Pages whose content has not changed are skipped, so the panel does not
  redraw for nothing.

A secret calendar address works like a password. Paperhue keeps it in the
Windows Credential Manager and shows only its host name. Events and to-dos
are drawn in memory and never saved on the computer.
[docs/CALENDARS.md](https://github.com/markhhm/ulani-epaper/blob/main/docs/CALENDARS.md)
shows where Google Calendar, Apple iCloud, Outlook and other services keep
the address.

### Message board

Two more page kinds for short notes: **留言板** (message board: the newest
six notes as coloured sticky notes) and **大字留言** (one big message: the
newest note alone, as large as it fits). Click **留言…** (Note…), write a
note of up to 300 characters, pick a colour and click **張貼並顯示** (Post
and show). Paperhue sends only the message board pages and switches the
device to the board page. Posting needs no internet. The same window lists
your notes, so you can delete one or clear them all. Paperhue keeps the
newest 50 notes on the computer.

### 顆粒感 (Grain) for photos

A new option above the photo pages sets how the seven colours are mixed
into finer shades. **標準** (Standard, the default) keeps the most detail;
**柔和** (Soft), **更柔和** (Softer) and **最平滑** (Smoothest) give calmer,
less grainy pictures with more visible bands of colour. The previews update
as you choose.

## Download

Download **Paperhue.exe** below and double-click it. There is nothing to
install.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11 with Bluetooth LE.
- A ULANI 7-colour e-paper device, paired with the PC once (see
  [First-time setup](https://github.com/markhhm/ulani-epaper#first-time-setup)).
- An internet connection only for the calendar pages.
- The app's screens are in Traditional Chinese; the
  [README](https://github.com/markhhm/ulani-epaper#readme) gives the English
  meaning of every label.

## First run

Paperhue.exe is not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your
PC" the first time. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## Upgrading from 0.2.2

- Replace your old Paperhue.exe with the new one. The device stays paired
  with the PC, so there is nothing to set up again.
- Pages now have a **顯示** (Show) menu. A new install starts with pages 1–3
  as calendar pages (月曆, 一週行程, 待辦清單) and page 4 as a photo page.
  To keep photos on all four pages as before, set pages 1–3 to **照片**
  (Photo). Paperhue remembers the choice.
- Nothing on the device changes until you push photos, sync or post a note,
  so the photos already on it stay until then.
- **推送照片到裝置** (Push photos to device) sends only the pages set to
  照片; the other pages are updated by 立即同步 or 張貼並顯示.
